extensionDescription.message: Convert web pages to Markdown format and download them

descriptionText.message: A Chrome extension that converts the web page you are viewing to Markdown format with one click and allows you to download it.

featureOneClickDesc.message: Simply click the extension icon to convert the displayed page to Markdown.

featurePreviewDesc.message: Preview the converted Markdown within the popup.

featureAutoFilenameDesc.message: Automatically sets the download filename based on the page's domain name.

featureEasyDownloadDesc.message: Save the .md file instantly from the "Download" button in the preview screen.

documentInstallText.message: Install this extension from the Chrome Web Store.

usageStep1.message: Open the web page you want to convert to Markdown.

usageStep2.message: Click the extension icon in the Chrome toolbar.

usageStep3.message: A popup opens and the page content is automatically converted to Markdown.

usageStep4.message: Preview the result in the "Download" tab and change the filename if needed.

usageStep5.message: Click the "Download" button to save the Markdown file.

siteAccessDescription.message: Allows this extension to read and change all your data on visited websites.

privacyStatement.message: We declare that we do not collect or use your data.

privacyDeclaration.message: We declare the following about your data:

privacyPoint1.message: Not sold to third parties for purposes other than approved use cases

privacyPoint2.message: Not used or transferred for purposes unrelated to the item's core functionality

privacyPoint3.message: Not used or transferred to determine creditworthiness or for lending purposes

warningNoAccess.message: Warning: Cannot access page. Please reload.

warningCannotGetHtml.message: Warning: Cannot get HTML from current tab.

errorNoHtml.message: Error: Could not retrieve HTML from page.
